audit.why: 55.3% over 1246 games. LeBlanc owns levels 1 through first item; Orianna flips it once Command: Shockwave has allies to follow it. Chart (LeBlanc x6, Orianna at 2+ items) agrees across both layers and with the packet.
Orianna's real lane spike is Command: Attack falling from 7s to 3s as it ranks, which turns her poke into a constant; her fight spike is R at 110/95/80. LeBlanc spikes at 2, 6 and first item.
audit.corrected: Q's cooldown curve added to spikes[0] and the cooldowns field.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly called the shield 'Dissonance'. Command: Dissonance (W, 7s, 225 range) is the damage pulse that leaves a slow field; the shield is Command: Protect (E, flat 9s, 1095 range), which also grants armour and MR to the ally it attaches to. wants.foe[2] also referenced 'Discord', which is not one of her abilities.
audit.why: Which spell to bait is the whole plan against Orianna, and the page named the wrong one. Command: Protect is also what makes the burst maths fail, since it shields plus resists.
audit.corrected: Shield reattributed to Command: Protect with its 9s cooldown; Dissonance restated as the slow field; 'Discord' removed. Added that Shockwave lands on the ball at 410 range, not on Orianna.

audit.why: Command: Protect's flat 9s is the window LeBlanc has to burst through, and R's 110s-to-80s is when a fight is safe to take.

edits.before: Orianna's early kit is entirely built around slow, deliberate ball placement — she has no dash, no blink, and no way to escape once you've closed the distance. Bait her Dissonance shield with the clone, since it's her only defensive tool, then punish the real engage once it's down; her damage output before her ball is fully utilized is low compared to your combo burst. Keep pressuring her ball position aggressively, since denying her the ability to set up Command: Attack removes most of her early lane presence.
edits.after: Orianna's early kit is entirely built around slow, deliberate ball placement — she has no dash, no blink, and no way to escape once you've closed the distance. Bait Command: Protect (E) with the clone: the shield is on a flat 9 seconds and is her only defensive tool, so send the real body while it is down. Command: Dissonance (W) is the slow field, not a shield, and it is what stops your walk-up — cross it on the Distortion dash. Deny her the ball and most of her early lane presence goes with it.

notes: Main correction: the page called the shield 'Dissonance' throughout. Command: Dissonance (W) is the slow/speed field; the shield is Command: Protect (E) on a flat 9s, and it also grants armour and MR. Also removed 'Discord', which is not an Orianna ability. Chart left untouched — it agrees with the packet and the win rate. Did not assert whether Command: Shockwave can pull LeBlanc mid-Distortion; the kit text does not say.
